title: Bill 160 statewide freshwater initiative agreement
summary: The council passed Bill 160, on a freshwater initiative, on first reading with seven ayes on December 5. The bill lets the mayor enter an agreement with government agencies on Oʻahu, Kauaʻi and Hawaiʻi Island. A council member said it strengthens Hawaiʻi's long-term water security by coordinating freshwater, stormwater, wastewater and recycled water.
